Never edit tracked lane files, registry, counters, entry, report, fleet repo, sibling lanes or shokuknow; the L1 integrates. No lane Git/jj mutation and no commit/push.
- Every clone, work tree, build, fixture and temp file lives under /fast/scratch/hyaku/mado-r48/<Seat>/; create it explicitly, `trap 'rm -rf -- "$S"' EXIT`, copy receipts to your seat dir before deleting. Never use /tmp; every loop/write bounded to 2 GB total and 1 MB/file. The L1's /fast scratch is not your seat path.

- Host: no compositor/service mutation, no input injection, no GUI or terminal launch. `xdg-terminal-exec` ONLY with a --print-* option and XDG_CACHE_HOME inside your scratch; `xkbcli` only compile-keymap/test/kccgst read verbs. - Fixture repos must be `D=$(mktemp -d -p /fast/scratch/hyaku/mado-r48/<Seat>) && git -C "$D" init -q`; every git call uses `-C "$D"`, verify the root equals D before any commit. No throwaway identity anywhere else.

- Data candidate location: the C1/C2 deliverables this wave attacks are committed with this wave's freeze at .ufo/waves/round-48/l1-draft/ (tool = l1-draft/mado-terminal.py; entry = l1-draft/xkb-keymap-compile-r48.md; rows = l1-draft/rows-c2.md; README row = l1-draft/readme-row.md) and the w1 seat dirs named in each task.
